blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Thursday said former President Rodrigo Duterte appeared to be doing well during his appearance before the International Criminal Court (ICC) on Wednesday, his first in-person appearance before the tribunal since his arrest 18 months ago. Duterte appeared before Trial Chamber III during the third status conference in his case, where he faces three counts of crimes against humanity in connection with his administration’s war on drugs. His previous appearance before the judges was on March 14, 2025, when he joined the proceedings via videoconference.
